author: Mark Atwood
text: API contract confidence (supplement pass #2): 35% chance of missed issue. Most confident: JMAP-ic0j.68 (direct line-by-line verification of all 14 sites in calendars-server plus cross-reference to mail-server canonical at email.rs/mailbox.rs/sieve.rs/submission.rs — total 327 grep hits workspace-wide before filtering worktrees and tests, ~100 production sites). Least confident: JMAP-ic0j.69 (engineering basis is sibling-within-same-crate consistency; labeled opinion because reasonable people may consider the 'static bound a deliberate literal-only cue). Uncertainty driven by: (a) did not run cargo public-api to enumerate the exposed surface across feature-on/feature-off builds; (b) did not run cargo doc to inspect rendered rustdoc HTML for the JMAP-ic0j.25/.27/.33 doc-section gaps post-fix; (c) did not cross-reference the seed_object signature shape against jmap-mail-server::MemoryBackend to determine which of the two shapes is canonical — if mail-server's MemoryBackend has no seed_object yet, .69 may need to be re-scoped as a workspace-template establishing decision rather than a calendars-vs-MockBackend divergence; (d) did not enumerate the cleanup_calendar_events Result<(), String> signature as its own finding because it's a private helper inside calendar.rs and the leak surfaces through .68's named site at calendar.rs:303, so filing it separately would double-count. Would raise confidence if: (a) ran cargo public-api against feature-on builds; (b) checked the canonical mail-server::MemoryBackend::seed_object signature; (c) ran a workspace-wide grep for the BackendChangesError::Other(e) parallel pattern in /changes /query handlers to confirm the leak is /set-only (it appears to be, but I did not exhaustively check).
